chain.text: **Estate:** 18 ha: 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay/flint soils. ~62,000 bottles/year; 2024: 48,000 after May hail destroyed ~20% of western plots. **Certification:** Organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion began 2023; three compliant years required, so earliest 2026. **Sales:** Export 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan. Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/L. **Failures:** 2022: tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; batch lost aroma, sold in bulk, €11,000 loss. Fixed: controllers calibrated pre-harvest; tank 4 has second probe. 2023: 900 bottles shipped with wrong vintage; all recalled. Fixed: label proofs need two signatures. **Rules:** No irrigation on western plots (2021 trial lowered acidity below Japanese threshold). Harvest dates set from sugar/acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar. Tanks above 28°C must be cooled within four hours. **Open:** Lighter bottles proposed 2025; Japanese importer unconfirmed; no cost comparison. Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down
